name: zclass_cls_di_build_pick_candidates_for_segment
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildPickCandidatesForSegment scans a root node's children, filters eligible pickable/raycastable variants, dispatches each child through the single-segment child fallback, and stops early on break-on-first hits.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this top-level single-segment child scan; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4455f0 validates the listCountB/listB child scan, enabled and raycastable flag gates, VariantTag::CurrentAllowsId gate, BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentChildFallback call with listCountB + 1, break-on-first candidate-count early exit, and return through the final listCountB/candidate-count state.
The native cls_di smoke verifies top-level segment dispatch through an eligible object child, candidate append behavior, node ownership, and integration with the single-segment child fallback cycle.
